profile.lead: Glitch hunter, speedrunner, and professional fun-haver.
profile.text: I live for the moment a game breaks in just the right way, whether I'm clipping through a wall to save three seconds or stumbling on a bug nobody's documented yet.

image.alt: The site's blue turtle avatar wearing sunglasses.

profile.text: The games that make my favorites list are the ones that hook me on the whole loop: the grinding, the progression, the discovery and the replayability.

dead_metal_jam.description: Play the right notes to blast robots in a 3D, on-rails factory shootout.
dead_metal_jam.alt: An orange G robot and a black C robot pose against dark factory hazard stripes.

triangle_rush.description: Chase highlighted triangles. Hit the matching key or tap each target before time runs out.
triangle_rush.alt: A glowing mint triangle numbered 1 leads two grey targets across diagonal blue and teal stripes.

desk_can_saw.description: Steer a tiny electric chainsaw through falling cans and keep the sparks flying.
desk_can_saw.alt: A blue toy chainsaw and tumbling cans on an orange and yellow hazard-striped cover.

chicken_pit.description: Pull for your coop in a 3D toy-farm tug-of-war, against a CPU or a friend.
chicken_pit.alt: Two toy chickens tug a rope above an open pit against a bright yellow sunburst.

lazer_nfc.description: Watch the toy robots play a melody, then repeat their colours to fire the laboratory laser.
lazer_nfc.alt: Three smiling toy robots in red, mint and yellow against a pale bubble pattern.

anti_chess.description: Give away every piece on a 3D chessboard. Captures are compulsory.
anti_chess.alt: A dark knight and a white pawn flank a fallen white king on a cream chessboard.

anti_checkers.description: Give your opponent every checker. Forced jumps turn familiar moves upside down.
anti_checkers.alt: A crowned stack of red checkers and cream pieces stand out against a burgundy sunburst.

creep_code.description: Work six enchanted puzzle mechanisms on a shifting stone stage to light a constellation.
creep_code.alt: An owl-eyed keeper beside a stone portal and floating blue crystal against a star chart.

cube_trials.description: Deliver spark plugs across bumpy 3D trails, free stranded cars, and build a trail of your own.
cube_trials.alt: A brown Nissan Cube on an orange-and-cream cover with green stripes and chequered blocks.

dolces_adventure.description: Run a hungry little dog through toy-like worlds. Leap pits, collect burgers, and stomp pests.
dolces_adventure.alt: A tan toy dog with a red collar faces a floating burger against a mint sky and yellow sun.

tifo_beato.description: Lead a miniature football terrace through chants, held notes, and rival sing-offs.
tifo_beato.alt: A yellow-clad capo with a megaphone leads a row of supporters on a striped navy cover.

tuki_tuki.description: Follow the arrows through five original songs on a 3D dance stage, solo or with a friend.
tuki_tuki.alt: A toy dancer in a rainbow-striped shirt is surrounded by bright directional arrows on a purple cover.

yacomio.description: Grow a 3D colony from a single microbe to civilization in an untimed evolution game.
yacomio.alt: A mint-green toy microbe with colourful beads and a tiny companion against a pale bubble pattern.

florida_men.description: Roll into a four-player board party, then chase toy gators and tackle six 3D minigames.
florida_men.alt: A green toy alligator, pink flamingo and blue ride-on mower against a mint confetti background.

rastro.description: Paint, fit, and fine-tune three everyday cars in a 3D garage. No races, no unlocks.
rastro.alt: A turquoise Nissan Cube sits inside a blueprint-style frame on a dark teal cover.

sailor_man.description: Trade musical calls in a toy-canal practice prototype, using buttons or an opt-in microphone.
sailor_man.alt: Blue P1 and red P2 toy launches on teal waves beneath a gold sun.

capitans_walk.description: Balance a walker and an eager dog on a springy leash through a seeded park in this physics prototype.
capitans_walk.alt: A walker and a black-and-white dog cross a green park with a long leash between them.

puppy_kraft.description: Explore, sniff, dig and build as a tiny dog in a saved block-world prototype. Keyboard and mouse.
puppy_kraft.alt: A blocky tan-and-white puppy stands on a tiny grass-topped platform in warm sunlight.

baloos_chase.description: Throw a ball, then chase Baloo through three 3D courses. A solo prototype with bouncy throws, obstacles and recovery medals.
baloos_chase.alt: A speckled white dog with dark ears and a red harness carries a golden ball against a sunny green garden.

rules: No copyrighted ROMs or game assets. Patches and tools, bring your own copy.
Every file says what it's for, what it was made with, and what it runs on.
Nothing goes up untested. If it's known-broken, the page says so.
